tasks.title: provenance: graph engine: noisy-OR, wash reset, time-forward
tasks.goal: A pure function that propagates allergen probabilities over interaction edges in time order, so any entity's profile at any t_ms can be computed from initial profiles plus events.
acceptance: propagate(initial_profiles, events, until_t_ms) sorts edges by (t_start_ms, event_id) and applies the noisy-OR update from ARCHITECTURE stage 5 with per-action k from ProvenanceSettings: test_noisy_or_matches_formula
direction a_to_b, b_to_a and both are honored; clean.wash multiplies every unit on a_id by (1 - p): test_direction and test_wash_reset
Entities in late_entities or first seen after shift start begin at probability 1 for every unit (OQ-13 default): test_unknown_history_starts_saturated

Hypothesis property, marked safety: shuffling input order never changes output, and an edge into a source that occurs after that source's outgoing edge never contaminates the target: uv run pytest components/provenance -m safety -k time_forward
Edges with t_start_ms > until_t_ms are ignored: test_until_cutoff
Golden scenarios knife-carries-peanut-to-plate, wash-resets-knife and time-order-blocks-path produce the expected allergens_reached for any k in (0, 1]: test_golden_reachability

tasks.title: provenance: verdict policy: fail closed, models only tighten
tasks.goal: One plain-code function decide(ticket, exact_result, laya_outcome, mode, input_health) -> Verdict that returns HOLD unless every check affirmatively passes.
acceptance: HOLD iff (exact flags or Laya flags) intersect the ticket's forbidden units, or confidence < ticket.pass_threshold, or any error, missing input or model_unavailable: table-driven test_decide_cases

Hypothesis property, marked safety: for every input and every Laya outcome (including any response, an exception and a timeout), decide(full) is hold whenever decide(rules_only) is hold, and flagged is a superset of exact flags: -k models_only_tighten
Hypothesis property, marked safety: safe_decide() wrapping any raised exception from any input accessor returns hold with reason error: -k fail_closed
In full mode a missing Laya outcome yields hold with model_unavailable; mode is recorded on the verdict: test_mode_recorded
ticket.exceptions never suppress a flag (OQ-2 default); trace_sensitive false is treated as true until the OQ-8 ADR: test_exceptions_do_not_loosen, test_trace_default_strict
Every output validates against verdict.schema.json (pass implies empty reasons and flagged): test_verdict_schema
Confidence uses a conservative placeholder 1 - max P(forbidden unit), replaceable by the provenance-05 ADR without changing decide()'s signature

tasks.title: provenance: exact reachability with chains + ExactLaya fake
tasks.goal: Build a plate's time-forward ancestor subgraph as a LayaRequest, compute which allergens reach the plate with the most probable chain per allergen, and expose it as ExactLaya implementing LayaClient.
acceptance: build_request(plate_id, ticket, state_snapshot, as_of_t_ms) returns a LayaRequest that validates against laya_request.schema.json and contains only time-forward ancestors: test_request_is_ancestor_subgraph
exact(request) returns per-allergen probability and a chain of chain_step objects ordered source to plate with strictly increasing t_ms: test_chain_time_ordered
ExactLaya.analyze(request, timeout_ms=...) satisfies the LayaClient Protocol and returns a valid laya_response: test_exact_laya_protocol
Golden scenarios knife-carries-peanut-to-plate and late-amendment-adds-dairy return chain_event_ids [e1, e2]: test_golden_chains

tasks.title: provenance: AdversarialLaya fakes and loosening tests
tasks.goal: Fakes that behave like a broken or hostile Laya, and a test suite proving none of them can turn a HOLD into a PASS.
acceptance: AdversarialLaya modes: random, empty (claims clean), late (exceeds timeout), malformed (fails schema), flipped (drops every allergen exact found), raises: test_modes_exist
The LayaClient adapter rejects malformed responses as model_unavailable instead of passing them through: test_malformed_is_unavailable
For every mode, on every golden scenario, the full-mode decision is never looser than rules_only, marked safety: -k adversarial

tasks.title: provenance: ADR for clean-confidence, flag thresholds, tie order
tasks.goal: Write the ADR that defines clean-confidence, how per-unit flag thresholds relate to ticket.pass_threshold and severity (OQ-4), and how equal or overlapping edge timestamps are ordered.
acceptance: ADR PR to docs/adr/ (Director merges) defines confidence as a function of reachability probabilities and input health, and proves it is monotone: more evidence of a forbidden allergen never raises it
Tie and overlap rule chosen so the stricter ordering always applies, with a worked example
Lists the property tests that will guard the definition, so provenance-02 can adopt it
Placeholder threshold defaults from OQ-4 recorded as config, flagged for owner sign-off

tasks.title: provenance: golden scenario runner in CI
tasks.goal: Every scenario in contracts/scenarios runs through engine + policy in rules_only mode on every PR, including amendments, and must match expected exactly.
acceptance: A pytest module parametrized over contracts/scenarios/*.json loads each one via the platform scenario loader into InMemoryStateClient: uv run pytest components/provenance -m safety -k golden
Amendments are replayed and every expected entry (plate, revision) is checked for decision, allergens_reached, reason_codes and chain_event_ids
Adding a new scenario file needs no code change (parametrization discovers it)
Fails loudly, with a diff of expected vs actual, on mismatch

tasks.title: provenance: ScriptedVerdictSource fake for experience
tasks.goal: A fake that writes verdict, verdict_step, entity_risk and mistake_pattern rows into InMemoryStateClient on a Clock schedule, so experience can build the expo board and gate before the real service exists.
acceptance: ScriptedVerdictSource(state, clock).play(path) replays contracts/fixtures/valid verdict and mistake_pattern fixtures, or a scenario's expected list: test_replays_fixtures
Emitted rows validate against their schemas: test_rows_valid
Documented in components/provenance/README.md with a one-line usage example

tasks.title: provenance: verdict service on StateClient
tasks.goal: A service that watches StateClient, computes a verdict from full history when a bound plate enters the pass zone or its ticket's revision bumps, and records it with its chain atomically.
acceptance: Triggers on entity.zone == pass for a bound plate, and on a ticket revision increase (recheck of full history, trigger ticket_amended): test_triggers
Every verdict is computed from scratch from full history, never incrementally from a previous verdict, marked safety: test_amendment_full_recheck
StateUnavailable or any exception while building inputs produces a HOLD verdict (recorded when the DB is back) and an ERROR log: test_state_unavailable_holds
Missing ticket, missing binding, or no entity update for the plate within the staleness window -> hold with missing_input or stale_track: test_input_health
Replaying each golden scenario through InMemoryStateClient yields the expected verdict rows: uv run pytest components/provenance -k service

tasks.title: provenance: entity_risk publisher for overlays
tasks.goal: Publish each entity's live propagated allergen profile to entity_risk so experience can color overlays.
acceptance: put_entity_risk called on change, rate-limited to about 5 Hz per entity, using an injected Clock: test_rate_limit
Unknown-history entities publish unknown: true until a wash resets them: test_unknown_published
Rows validate against allergen_profile.schema.json: test_risk_schema

tasks.title: provenance: consolidated safety suite and fault injection
tasks.goal: One discoverable safety suite covering invariants 1, 2, 5, 8 and 9 with a reusable fault-injection harness, ready for safety reviewer sign-off (ROADMAP M1 exit).
acceptance: A fault-injection wrapper raises at every StateClient and LayaClient call site in turn; every run ends in hold: -m safety -k fault_injection
Property tests for invariants 1, 2, 5, 8 and 9 exist and are listed in components/provenance/SAFETY.md with what each proves
uv run pytest components/provenance -m safety runs in CI on every PR and finishes in under 2 minutes
review:safety-approved recorded on the PR by the safety reviewer

tasks.title: provenance: run against real local SpacetimeDB
tasks.goal: Swap InMemoryStateClient for the real StateClient against a local SpacetimeDB and meet the rules-only latency budget.
acceptance: record_verdict writes verdict and verdict_step atomically; a killed process never leaves a verdict without its chain: test_atomic_record (integration, marked slow)
Plate-at-pass to verdict row <= 200 ms p95 in rules_only on golden scenarios, measured and reported in the PR
The same golden runner passes against the real client: uv run pytest components/provenance -m 'safety and slow' -k real_state

tasks.title: provenance: gate on sim's observation-complete corpus
tasks.goal: Run sim's committed CI subset through engine + policy on every PR, with zero false passes allowed and the false-hold rate reported.
acceptance: For scenarios tagged generated and observation-complete: any expected hold that we pass fails CI, marked safety: -k sim_corpus
False-hold rate printed as a CI summary line and tracked in the PR description
Scenarios without the observation-complete tag are reported but never fail CI
out_of_scope: Tuning k to lower false holds
